author: Paul Cook
text: I had this on 2 sensors about 3 months ago (during January) and if I scanned them they both worked but would not transmit to phone, same problem? Once the second one had done its 14 days (as an electronic engineer) I took it apart did some checks and the battery was very flat and the Bluetooth component was working at 500kps (should be 1Mb) as they use low energy Bluetooth, so it was very out of range.  As they both came from the same prescription (batch) I assume the batteries may have been old (they’re not replaceable) and chalked it up to poor QC by Abbott!
